## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      1 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 4, 2026 - Aug 4, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Fadi Mujahid_, Aug 4, 2026, 3/5: "The app is very good at what it does and I purchased the premium app. However, the app keeps Google Play Service up all the time which results in battery drainage, which is very frustrating. Unlike other apps which might use Google services to check on the purchase, this app checks with this service on each click. Very unprofessional"

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      1 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Sep 18, 2026 - Sep 18, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Mohsen_, Sep 18, 2026, 5/5: "I used this app for almost 2 years, it has always been great. I don't remember if I ever encountered a bug or problem. The only reason I had to switch to a different app was that HabitNow does not provide an easy way to sync between devices. I remember I had to spend long durations to think about writing/managing tasks and habits and I'd rather do long tasks with a laptop with a proper desk and posture. Spending long durations on HabitNow on my phone always led to bad posture and neck pain."
<!--/ir-theme-->
